problem: The caption says the 20% serial curve "flattens at 400 req/s" at 16 servers, but section 1 states the ceiling for s=0.2 is 1/s = 5×, i.e. 500 req/s. The curve only reaches 400 at 16 servers and is still rising towards 500, so the caption can make a student think 400 is the asymptote.
fix: With 16 servers the ideal line reaches 1,600 req/s, while a 20% serial part has climbed only to 400 req/s and is still creeping towards its 500 req/s ceiling. Notice that more servers cannot remove the serial work.
